title: Python: two wrong-edge defects found in the TS review: C.__class__ alias with def __class__, and isUnshadowedBuiltin trusting an incomplete star export set (DEC-303 (a57) items 2 and 3)
description: DEC-303 (a57) items 2 and 3, found by the Opus round 1 of opum-ai/glyph-cli#194 (TS, GCLI-119); both predate #194 and are NOT fixed there. Item 2: in f = C.__class__; f() where in-repo C defines def __class__, resolveAliasCall resolves f to that def, but Python finds type's data descriptor __class__ first, so C.__class__ is the metaclass, not the def: a wrong edge against Python's attribute lookup (src/python/calls.ts resolveAliasCall, rhs kind attr). Item 3: isUnshadowedBuiltin (rules 37 and K1) trusts a complete star import's export set that the code itself records as incomplete (the starMayBind comment: a for or with-as target, a walrus, a match capture, a list or nested or starred target and a global write are missed), against (a12)(b), under which a partial star import shadows builtins. Record only on filing; the fix is a later change under the same task, lands before the freeze, and joins (a49) item 7's hold list. Not in scope: an in-repo MRO entry overriding __getattribute__ (named in (a57) item 4, inherited blind spot, no special case).

acceptanceCriteria.text: f = C.__class__; f() with in-repo C defining def __class__ (as a method, a property and an attribute) resolves no edge to that def: a refused fixture asserting no edge and the exact bin delta, red before and green after, and a positive twin where C defines no __class__ still resolving as before

a name a module-level star import may bind through a form the export set misses (for target, with-as, walrus, match capture, list or nested or starred target, global write) is not claimed as the unshadowed builtin by isUnshadowedBuiltin: one refused fixture per binding form asserting the bin delta, each red before and green after, with a positive twin for a star import whose set is complete
each item has a mutant by name observed red

the five-pin corpus diff (flask 49943b5a, httpx 7cff5f79, jinja 5ef70112, rich 3a109ccd, tqdm 9cf5a12b) is script-asserted against dev with every moved site named; any in-repo edge created or removed goes to opum-doc before the clear

finalSummary:
Landed as opum-ai/glyph-cli#210 (squash e1dc2fc7) after Opus round 1 BLOCK at cd0d6d1 and round 2 APPROVE at db921f57. Item 2: f = C.__class__; f() no longer resolves to an in-repo def __class__ (resolveAliasCall refuses attr __class__; the rest of the data-descriptor family is GCLI-134). Item 3: isUnshadowedBuiltin and isStarPossiblyBuiltin trust a complete star set only when starSetIsExact holds (a plain unconditional literal __all__, or every public module-scope binding of the target in the set and its own stars exact); any doubt means the star may bind the name. Round 1 found a new wrong staticmethod edge (isStarPossiblyBuiltin left trusting the set) and two __all__ certification holes, fixed in db921f57. Verified by fixtures red on dev and green after, mutants M2a, M2b, M3a to M3f, M-cond and M-bare observed red, and the five-pin corpus output byte-identical to dev (sha256 4839ad00c598e09909a8ed7f6f3f2450ef91502b8cde22d71c5ea0bbbba7c9ce). Review findings F1 to F5 are recorded on GCLI-135.

Caveat on criterion 1: of the three def forms only the method form (and a def in an in-repo base) was red on dev; the property and attribute forms were already refused on dev and are pinned as guards, so 'red before' holds for the method form only.
